summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Churvox Phase 1 Batch 2: Business isolation, roles, team workflow, jobs structure cleanup. All 17 backend API tests passed. Frontend UI testing verified employer/worker role-based features, team management, job assignment workflow, and logo cleanup.
passed_tests: Employer login returns role (employer/admin) and business_id
Dashboard stats includes team_count for employer
POST /api/team/workers - employer can create worker account
GET /api/team/workers - employer can list workers
DELETE /api/team/workers/{id} - employer can delete worker
Worker login with john@churvox.com / Worker123! works correctly
Worker cannot create jobs (returns 403)
Worker cannot delete jobs (returns 403)
Job created with assigned_worker_id has status 'assigned'
Worker can acknowledge job (POST /api/jobs/{id}/acknowledge changes status to acknowledged)
Worker can start job (status → in_progress)
Worker can complete job (status → completed, auto-creates invoice)
New job defaults to 'assigned' status (not scheduled/cancelled)
Business isolation: worker can see clients from same business
GET /api/clients/{id}/jobs returns job history for client
Worker only sees jobs assigned to them (not all business jobs)
Employer dashboard shows stats grid with 6 cards + team count + quick actions
Worker dashboard shows only 3 stats cards (no revenue/invoices/clients)
Worker dashboard does NOT show quick actions (New Job/Quote/Client/Invoice)
Worker sidebar shows only Dashboard, Jobs, Calendar, Clients, Settings (no Team/Quotes/Invoices/Plans)
Employer sidebar shows Team link under 'More' section
Team page: Add Worker button, worker cards with delete button
Job Form page: 'Assign Worker (optional)' dropdown visible
Client Detail page: Job History section with job count and list
Calendar page renders correctly with job status colors
Quotes page renders without errors (uses QUOTE_STATUSES)
Invoices page renders without errors (uses INVOICE_STATUSES)
Logo appears transparent/clean on login, signup, forgot-password pages (mix-blend-mode: screen)
Mobile view: bottom nav with More dropdown includes Team for employer

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all pages render correctly, role-based features verified)

seed_data_creation: Admin user seeded on startup. Worker john@churvox.com created via API tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Churvox Phase 1 Batch 2 is complete. Business isolation implemented (all data filtered by business_id). Employer/worker roles working correctly. Team management (employer creates worker accounts with temp password). Job assignment workflow: assigned → acknowledged → in_progress → completed. Job statuses are only: assigned, acknowledged, in_progress, completed (no scheduled/cancelled). Logo uses mix-blend-mode: screen for transparent appearance on dark backgrounds. Worker john@churvox.com exists with password Worker123!.
